payload.question: Did the council set the council tax it said it would?
payload.label: A 2.99% council tax rise, taking Band D to £315.26

target.display: "The proposed 2026-2027 Band D rate is therefore £315.26 compared to the current year rate of £306.11 – an increase of £9.15." — Cabinet, 11 February 2026

actual.display: Council resolved exactly that on 24 February 2026

payload.evidence: Cabinet proposed £315.26 on 11 February 2026. Thirteen days later the statutory resolution passed by full Council set the basic amount of council tax at £315.26. The council did what it said it would do, on time. Green here means a promise kept. It is not a view on whether the rise was a good idea: that is a question for you, not for a rule. The rise was 2.99%, just under the 3% above which a district council must hold a referendum.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
